CHROMIUM: ASoC: Intel: eve: Add map for new DAIs for Multi-Playback & Echo Ref Modified DAPM Machine map for eve machine to suit the toplogy change, required to enable features: Multi-Endpoint Playback Echo Reference Capture NOTE: cherrypicked changes taken for EVE machine only, from upstream commit:0b06122fc8d0949a0aa7b817d98e031104802611 BUG=b:37753089 TEST= build and boot. verify basic audio isn't regressed. With the patch series and dependencies merged, validate features: 1. AEC: a. Able to see "ACE capture" capture device in "arecord -l" b. Able to simulataeneously record the playback, cmds: aplay -Dhw:0,0 -f S24_LE -r 48000 -c 2 <play.wav> -vv & arecord -Dhw:0,4 -c2 -f S24_LE <capture.wav> -r 48000 -d20 -vv 2. Multi-Endpoint Playback: a. Able to see "Headset Audio" play device in "aplay -l" b. Able to simultaeneously play seperate audio stream at speaker and headset. CQ-DEPEND=CL:637591 Change-Id: Ia5ea17f69b4e3cb8ee84dc106f2aa038feb73a38 Signed-off-by: Naveen M <naveen.m@intel.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/637592 Commit-Ready: Cheng-Yi Chiang <cychiang@chromium.org> Tested-by: Cheng-Yi Chiang <cychiang@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Cheng-Yi Chiang <cychiang@chromium.org>
